exposure: Severity of intrahepatic cholestasis (mild, moderate, severe)
cohort: 140 pregnant women with intrahepatic cholestasis and 560 pregnant women without intrahepatic cholestasis (controls)
finding: Pregnant women with intrahepatic cholestasis had a higher risk of neonatal respiratory distress syndrome and postpartum hemorrhage compared to pregnant women without intrahepatic cholestasis, even after adjusting for gestational age at birth and mode of delivery.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery was adjusted for as a potential confounder when analyzing the risk of respiratory distress syndrome in neonates.
